svg.aria-label: Nerva — AI operations workspace · In progress
svg.title: Nerva — AI operations workspace · In progress
svg.desc: Workspace designed for AI agents that propose business actions for a human to approve. Built so far: session auth, workspaces, the approval flow and read-only Gmail import. The agent layer is next. Strict typing end to end.
